notes.title: Tour de France 2022 - Available June 9!
notes.notes:
Hello riders!

A new game mode and a range of improvements are coming with Tour de France 2022! The game celebrating the third-most-followed competition in the world returns this year with 14,000km of racing across four different countries. 

Enjoy four game modes and manage 26 teams. The world's top cyclists, such as Tadej Pogačar, Mathieu van der Poel, Wout van Aert, Primož Roglič and David Gaudu, are available to race with players in the game's 92 cycling stages.

[b]Tour de France 2022[/b] will be available on [b]June 9[/b], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767560/?snr=2_groups_partnerevents_]add it to your wishlist now[/url]!

[h2]Announcement Trailer[/h2]

[previewyoutube=MLglp2GkIpo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]2022 Features[/h2]

[b]New game mode[/b]
Tour de France 2022 introduces the all-new Race of the Moment mode, in which you can compare your results online with others players in ranked weekly challenges.

[b]The new official course of the 2022 Tour de France[/b]
Like previous years, players can race around France, this year starting from Denmark. All 21 official new stages are in the game, including the time trial in Copenhagen to start, then Lille Métropole – Arenberg Porte du Hainaut and its cobbled sections, the iconic Hautacam climb in the 18th stage, and the final flat stage on the famous Avenue des Champs-Elysées in Paris.

[b]More varied racing situations[/b]
The game's artificial intelligence now offers a wider range of behaviours, which are better tailored to races and events. You will experience early breakaways more often and enjoy better collaboration in breakaways.

[b]New classic race[/b]
Inspired by a famous Italian race, the Primavera Classic has arrived!

[b]New playable teams[/b]
Eolo-Kometa Cycling Team, Caja Rural-Seguros RGA and Uno-X Pro Cycling Team join the game for the first time.

[b]Race incidents[/b]
You now have the option to enable or disable falls and illnesses as well as set the frequency when enabled. The consequences vary depending on the severity of the incident.

[b]Race preparation[/b]
This new system randomly selects five cyclists to be well prepared and five others who could potentially under-perform. This encourages you to keep a close eye on your competitors as well as you own team.

[b]More immersive cobbled sections[/b]
When racing on these difficult sections, the user interface shudders, just like cyclists experience in real life. You have never experienced the Arenberg trench like this before.

notes.title: Patch Notes - September Update
notes.notes:
Hello riders, 

A new update for Tour de France 2021, ([b]v.02.09.00.529[/b]) is now available to download on your Steam client. This update brings at last the official equipment, update the ratings of riders following the recent events but also fixes some issues reported by the community.

Please read the Patch Notes below to learn more about the content added.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Update of official equipment (frames, wheels, helmets) for Lotto Soudal, Bora Hansgrohe, Bahrain Merida, Deceuninck Quick Step, Jumbo Visma and Israël Start Up Nation.
[*] Update of generic equipment (frames, wheels, helmets). 
[*] Update of rider ratings to reflect their performances in the Tour de France and other recent events. 
[*] Update of the riders registered for the Critérium du Dauphiné. 
[*] Reduction in the impact of the Stamina rating on stages under 180 km. 
[*] Improvement to sprints, with sprinters making better use of their teammates. 
[*] Improvement to maximum speed of opponents riding downhill when there is a breakaway to catch up. 
[*] Improvement in the results of individual time-trials. 
[*] Improvement in the position of favourites inside the peloton. 
[*] The size of breakaways in the final stages of the Tour de France has been increased. 
[*] Correction of minor bugs in the interface. [/list]

Thank you for your continuous source feedback here on Steam and on our social media, our team keeps working on improving the quality of the game!

notes.title: Redesigned My Tour Mode revealed!
notes.notes:
Hello cycling fans!

Today we are pleased to reveal the new [b]My Tour mode[/b] features in Tour de France 2021. In My Tour mode, explore your creative side. Create your own competition by selecting stages among the 89 available.

[previewyoutube=AOP6XO0XUbI;full]https://youtu.be/AOP6XO0XUbI[/previewyoutube]

Start with a time trial between Changé and Laval, followed by a mountain stage from Cluses to Tignes, and finish with one of the big Classics, such as Paris-Roubaix or Liège-Bastogne-Liège.  Choose your dream stages to create a unique competition. You will also obviously want to choose some rest days to give your riders time to recover.

As well as stages, you can select the participating teams from some of the most famous ones, like Jumbo-Visma, Groupama-FDJ and Ineos Grenadiers, as well as the riders in each team.

Finally, the statistics of the biggest champions can be edited and saved in three databases, resulting in even more difficulty tuning options.
